title: Contour Refinement using Discrete Diffusion in Low Data Regime
mechanism: A lightweight CNN + self-attention discrete diffusion model, conditioned on a segmentation mask, iteratively denoises a sparse contour representation; built for fewer than 500 training images.
adaptation: Refine outlines of predicted inactive regions (42 train cells, labels well aligned); contours converted back to filled masks.
min_experiment: Arm: contour diffusion on PF inactive masks. Baseline: PF ensemble. Metric: inactive IoU on 5-fold CV. Kill: < +0.01.
evidence: R: beat several SOTA baselines on KVASIR, competitive on HAM10K and a smoke dataset, with < 500 training images and 3.5x faster inference.

alt_notes.adaptation: Inactive boundaries only; low value because inactive boundaries are already accurate (1 px shift IoU 0.94).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: contour refiner on inactive. Baseline: house ensemble. Metric: inactive IoU. Kill: < +0.02.
